signals.text: These initiatives include our Community Music Day, Get Up & Dance, our partnership with Cuckfield Bookfest, termly sports festivals, Wednesday ‘open labs’ and school Shakespeare performances among others.
From ballet to street dance, modern to Charleston, our weekly clubs and curriculum sessions mean Dance is part of the rhythm of everyday life at Cumnor.

Raising the bar, and drawing on her background in textile design, our dedicated Head of Art encourages children to work with a wide range of materials and processes in both 2D and 3D media, including sketching, painting, printmaking, textiles, ceramics, sculpture and animation.

With nine ensembles meeting each week and more than 80% of pupils in Years 3 and 4 learning an instrument, there are plenty of opportunities to get involved, make music with others and discover just how much they can achieve.

Kerrie Pope, Head of Art Joined by inspirational artists and art educators, our children regularly enjoy masterclasses, all taking place in the Art Studio, a dedicated, light-filled space with a mezzanine area for our Scholars’ enrichment program.

The perfect way to begin the festive season!
Discover beautiful gifts, festive finds and something special for everyone on your list.
Join us to share in the experience.
Every moment, extraordinary
Cumnor House Sussex offers an outstanding contemporary education for 2 to 13 year olds, built on our commitment to individual opportunity, excellence and community.
We nurture individual, unique potential and believe every moment is an opportunity to unlock exciting new possibilities. Every child belongs.
Preparing for the future
A Cumnor education prepares children for entry into the best senior schools in the country. Broad and rich, it is distinctly contemporary in its approach, designed to ignite a love of learning and lay foundations for life.
Preparing for the future
Discover Pupil Stories
Teddy
Dramatic Presence
Teddy joined Cumnor at the beginning of Year 5 and immediately stole our hearts. Coming from a Steiner school, this amazing young woman, with her gentle smile, tangible warmth and eagerness to learn has accelerated academically. Within a few weeks, she was on the stage with a lead role in the Year 5 musical, where we realised just what talent she had modestly hidden from the world.
To hear her sing, to see her eyes light up, to feel the joy and emotion of performance flow through her is just wonderful. She’s thrown herself into everything here, and brings a sense of peace and togetherness to her friendships. But the stage remains her happy place, and we love seeing her there too.
Hugo
Growth Mindset
You will struggle to find a more willing, keen, enthusiastic learner than Hugo.
He is by nature diligent and very conscientious, and given his learning needs, he continues to show great perseverance and determination in all of his academic subjects. He has flourished through our Kudos curriculum, where he has not only been able to demonstrate his skills and knowledge in different ways, but has also found opportunities such as our Entrepreneurship program that have harnessed his creativity and social intelligence.
Cheerful, eager, full of positivity and engagement with occasional bouts of genuine charm, he is a much loved boy here at Cumnor. He has a fantastic attitude to life, always willing to put up his hand and ‘have a go’; he will certainly go a long way in life.
Aggie
Competitive Spirit
Aggie is full of potential energy. Around school, she is relaxed, easy-going, affable; immensely popular, she is loved for her non-judgemental heart and her slightly goofy humour. Quietly diligent and conscientious, she has secured a place at Brighton College, testimony to her growing academic confidence and her great attitude.
But then you put her onto the sports pitch, and suddenly she transforms. Tall, athletic, powerful, she is brave, she is competitive and she exudes talent. An A team player across all the sports, she is a genuine all-rounder at this stage, as accomplished in a technical sport such as cricket or hockey, as she is on the athletics track or football pitch. And yet, despite all the medals and personal accolades, she comes off the pitch and is immediately her humble, kind and thoughtful self.
Aphelia
Exceptional Mind
Quiet, humble, enduringly kind, Aphelia possesses one of the sharpest minds in the school.
A prolific reader, her intelligence combines empathy and perspicacity with a quick and insightful logic. She loves to learn, and her natural conscientiousness means that she thrives in the demands of a truly stretching academic scholarship route. She is witty, she is incredibly creative both on paper and on canvas, and she is a deeply loyal friend. For one so insightful, she is incredibly unjudgemental. She is someone for whom we are really excited, proof that worth is found in someone’s heart as well as their mind, especially when you have a mind as dynamic as hers.
Ruby
Boarding Enthusiast
Ruby joined us in Year 6, and as soon as she arrived, you could sense her drive and determination to do well.
Coming from a different educational stream, she had some initial hurdles, but such is her natural ability and sheer diligence, she quickly found her feet and began to blossom, securing a place at Brighton College within that first year.
She is talented, especially on the stage where her natural charisma, her beautiful voice, and her ability to project character all come to the fore. Yet where she has especially thrived has been in our Boarding environment, which has developed not only her thirst for independence, but also deepened her friendships, which matter deeply to her. In a world that values EQ as much as IQ, she is developing all the relevant skills to really carve out an amazing life for herself.
Otto
Young Entrepreneur
Otto is a real gem. His is a keen, creative mind.
Once he’s into something, he wants to pursue it as much as he can, whether that be his encyclopaedic knowledge of military planes, his love of nature and especially local birdlife, his passion for skateboarding or latterly his entrepreneurial ventures.
Indeed, through our Entrepreneurship program, he has now created a thriving business, full of beautiful design and thoughtful branding. There is a gentle purpose about him, warm and generous, yet not afraid of hard work and meeting challenge. Equally as happy with his peers, or working on his latest project, he brings a creative calm and joy to our school.
Nakiso
Positive Presence
Nakiso arrived in 2023 as one of our Foundation Scholars. The first thing you notice about her is her smile, and wherever she is around the Cumnor campus, she exudes positivity. She never takes the opportunities on offer here at Cumnor for granted, and is utterly wholehearted in everything she does. She is strong, conscientious and engaged, with a diligent heart and mind that means that her progress in all areas of school life has been rapid.
What Nakiso loves most about Cumnor are her friends, whom she blesses with her kindness, steadiness and loyalty. All children deserve a place to put down their roots and blossom, and that is just what Nakiso is doing.

A vibrant community, there for everyone
Cumnor is more than the sum of its parts. What makes us more is our community. A home from home, where every family is welcomed, supported and celebrated.

Incredible staff, that know every child
Cumnor’s staff are outstanding. They are more than skilled educators: they are compassionate individuals who get to know every pupil in their care. This is the Cumnor difference that your child will experience – an environment where they know they are valued, understood, and can learn in a way that works for them.

Henry Tresidder
Director of Pastoral Tracking
Henry is a dedicated, charismatic and dynamic teacher with a deep commitment to Prep school life. His extensive experience in pastoral care combined with honesty, warmth, integrity and a positive outlook means he is an outstanding role model for pupils. Under Henry’s care and attention, every child feels valued, supported, and inspired to achieve their personal best.
Having joined Cumnor nine years ago, Henry is also Deputy Designated Safeguarding Lead, Head of Religion & Philosophy, Head of History and a Year 7 Form Tutor. Passionate about inspiring young minds both in and out of the classroom, he is currently training with the RFU for an England Rugby Coaching Award (ERCA).
Emma Howe
Head of Future Schools
Emma’s extensive teaching and consultancy background means she is ideally placed to guide our parents and children as they navigate Pre-Test preparation and senior school pathways. Her love of problem solving and passion for a range of subjects, combined with her down to earth approach, is instrumental in providing thorough and targeted academic support. You are in very capable hands!
Graduating with a BA in Linguistics and Phonetics, followed by a PGCE with English specialism, Emma spent four years advising parents as an Educational Consultant at Gabbitas before joining St Paul’s Juniors, London where she taught for 13 years, latterly as Head of Year 4 and overseeing 8+ entry. Emma joined Cumnor in 2018, teaching across the school, and has since held various roles on the Academic

The perfect way to begin the festive season!

Welcome to Cumnor Nursery
An unrivalled, nurturing experience for your child as they begin to explore the world around them and make their earliest steps on a learning journey.
It is our great delight to welcome you to Cumnor Nursery, a place where you can look forward to an unrivalled, nurturing experience for your child, where they can thrive and begin to explore the world around them.
Our purpose-built Nursery provides a truly wonderful, bespoke space for exploration, creation and discovery through play, without limits. With direct access to dedicated outdoor space and sweeping views across the South Downs, we have created something quite special.
We offer a truly flexible approach with 7am to 7pm provision, across 50 weeks of the year. We would love to show you the kind of nursery experience you and your child could enjoy so please don’t hesitate to get in touch to arrange a visit. We also host a weekly Baby & Toddler Group on Fridays – a great opportunity to get to know us better!
In the meantime, why not find out more about our multi award-winning Nursery below and take a look at our FAQs.
Emily Tier and Louise Hackett
Passionate & experienced
Passionate & experienced
Our team are highly trained and committed to providing the highest standards of care and education in a welcoming, homely atmosphere. We understand and celebrate the unique qualities in every child and go above and beyond to ensure Nursery is an enjoyable and positive experience for all of them.
Award- winning
Award- winning
That’s why for seven consecutive years we have received the Top 20 Nurseries South East England award, based on reviews from parents and carers.
My child has absolutely flourished at Cumnor Nursery.
Home from home
Home from home
Families build incredibly close bonds with us, and most move on to Cumnor Reception. We warmly welcome parents throughout the term, to experience their children’s first Sports Day, Nativity and concerts, and we pride ourselves on being an open, welcoming place as much for our parents as for our children.

Welcome to Pre-Prep
The early years are not just a stepping stone. They are the foundation on which everything else is built, and we believe they should be nothing short of extraordinary.
The motivation to learn is a powerful force. At Cumnor, we nurture children’s natural curiosity, encouraging them to ask questions, embrace new challenges and discover what they are capable of.
Childhood matters. These formative years are a time for exploration, creativity and growing confidence, as children develop the foundations for everything that follows. Our approach combines academic ambition with the freedom to discover, create and play, in an environment where every child is known as an individual, encouraged to find their strengths and supported to flourish.
We believe an outstanding contemporary education should nurture the whole child, giving equal importance to learning, wellbeing, character and the experiences that make childhood memorable.
Strong relationships underpin everything we do. We work in close partnership with parents, sharing in each child’s progress and working together to help them thrive. It is this sense of shared purpose, alongside the warmth of our community, that makes Cumnor such a special place to learn and grow.
As both Head of Pre-Prep and a parent, I know first-hand what a special place this is. If this is the kind of beginning you want for your child, we would be delighted to welcome you.
Sarah Gibson
Head of Pre-Prep and Nursery
Discover a learning adventure
Discover a learning adventure
The Early Years at Cumnor are the stepping stones where early learnings are reinforced, and new habits are created for life. We think of it as an adventure, and like all adventures, every path will be different.
Experience & expertise
Experience & expertise
We are experts in child development and pastoral care is central to all we do. We provide highly individualised care so our children feel understood. Each child is noticed, every moment is meaningful, and a strong foundation for life is built. From this, their learning will flourish.
Come and see Cumnor Pre-Prep
A very warm welcome awaits! We would be delighted to see you.

Welcome to Prep
As children grow, their world expands. Prep is where new possibilities take shape, strengths emerge and confidence grows.
Cumnor is an outstanding school that produces dynamic and creative young people, well prepared and ready for their next steps, confident of who they are and what they can do.
What they do is remarkable: with just over 250 pupils in our Prep school, we have built an enviable track record, with over 60% of last year’s leavers winning scholarships to the top senior schools across the country.
We believe the individualised attention that every child in our school receives is what sets us apart, and it is what enables all our pupils to achieve such outstanding results. It takes the collective energy of our whole community – our staff, children and parents – to create; but as we see our pupils go on to flourish in the wider world, we believe we are watching our vision come to life.
I would be delighted to share more of what, where and how we do things at Cumnor. I very much hope that you and your family will want to come and see for yourself what makes our school such an exceptional experience.
Fergus Llewellyn
Academic excellence
Academic excellence
Cumnor delivers a contemporary education, empowering, challenging and nurturing every child. We ignite curiosity and confidence, developing healthy learning habits for life and encouraging them to discover their own unique path and talents.
We believe that learning should be a fun, action-packed journey, with plenty of opportunity for learning outside the classroom, to create moments and memories that will last a lifetime. Because we want all our pupils to be the best they can possibly be, confident of who they are and what they can do.
Be valued, be heard be known
Be valued, be heard be known
The Cumnor difference is in our pastoral framework, designed to enable every child to learn about themselves, to realise their full potential and go on to achieve as happy, well-balanced young people.

A warm welcome awaits. Our informal personal visits will show you why Cumnor is an exceptional experience.

Welcome to Cumnor
Choosing the right school for your child – for your whole family, in fact – is a big decision; but one that we know you will be confident to make once you have seen for yourself what makes Cumnor so special.
Cumnor is home to more than 400 children, from Nursery to Year 8, each with their own personality, interests and potential.
We want every child to feel known, valued and inspired to discover what they can achieve. Our open, friendly and collaborative community gives children the time, space and encouragement to grow in confidence, develop their strengths and find their own path.
We are a non-selective school and welcome new families at all entry points. We combine individual support with high expectations, helping each child to flourish in their own way. We are immensely proud of what our pupils go on to achieve, including outstanding scholarship success and places at some of the country’s leading senior schools.
Getting to know each child begins with getting to know their family. We take the time to understand your child’s personality, interests and aspirations, so that we can offer the right support and opportunities for them to thrive.
We would love to show you around Cumnor and give you a real sense of what makes our school special. Come and see us – we would be delighted to meet you!
Rebecca Bruce
Admissions process
Admissions process
1. Get in touch
2. Come and see us
3. Register
4. Taster Day
5. Offer & place accepted
6. Joining Us
1. Get in touch
We would love to hear from you. Please do not hesitate to call or email our Registrar, Rebecca Bruce on registrar@cumnor.co.uk | 01825 740347.
2. Come and see us
We offer informal, personal tours of our school, to fit into your schedule, at any time during the term and during our dedicated Open Weeks. There’s plenty of time to meet our pupils and staff, explore our village-like campus and beautiful grounds, and ask all the questions that matter to you.
3. Register
We would encourage you to register early, particularly for the Nursery and Pre-Prep. After you have had a chance to visit us, we will invite you to complete our online Registration Form to progress your application. On receipt of this and the (non-refundable) Registration Fee, we will progress to organising a Taster Day.
4. Taster Day
All children who are registered for the Prep or Pre-Prep will be invited for a Taster Day. This is a chance for your child to find out what a typical school day feels like at Cumnor, and for us to get to know them. It is also an opportunity for you to experience the warmth and hospitality of our community, and learn about how our families become involved. In the Prep school, each child is allocated a ‘buddy’ to guide them through the day and show them the fun bits! For Nursery children, a shorter Taster Session will be arranged.
5. Offer & place accepted
Following the Taster Day, we hope to be in a position to offer a place, subject to availability. Your child’s place is secured on receipt of the full deposit and signed Parent Contract.
6. Joining Us
A warm welcome awaits! Whatever stage you join at Cumnor, we are on hand to support both you and your child for a smooth transition into the routines of Cumnor life.

Drama and Dance
Drama and Dance at Cumnor are more than just subjects; they are spaces for expression, discovery and joy.
Through our extensive Drama and Dance Programme, children learn to interact with others, becoming intuitive and agile communicators, and growing in self-belief.
From the very first steps in Reception to the final bow in Year 8, every child takes part in a journey that celebrates imagination, builds confidence, and nurtures creativity. Our belief is simple, but powerful; every child has a voice worth hearing and a story worth telling.
We have a duty as teachers to create memories. Our Drama Scholarship Programme supports students to reach ever higher and fulfil their potential. It has enabled our keenest and most talented pupils win Drama Scholarships to Brighton College, Worth, Eastbourne, Tonbridge, King’s Canterbury, Hurstpierpoint and Ardingly over the last few years.
Mrs Harris, Director of drama
Drama
Drama
Every single child from Reception to Year 8 will have the opportunity to perform in at least one of our 30+ events each year. From intimate coffee concerts and drama showcases, to seasonal concerts, variety shows, nativity plays, musicals and our annual set piece, the outdoor Shakespeare performance.
Whether their dream is to perform centre-stage, to design the set, create the stage make-up or be a sound or lighting technician, every child has an important role to play.
LAMDA
LAMDA
Drama at Cumnor opens doors, builds futures and creates lasting confidence. As part of our Performing Arts Programme, from Year 4 we offer the opportunity to work towards London Academy of Music and Dramatic Arts (LAMDA) examinations.
A wonderful way to learn important life skills, pupils take part in fun, imaginative and expressive lessons, encouraging confidence and the development of communication and physical awareness. Each grade encourages and challenges different aspects of text, language, creativity and vocal strength; inspiring young minds to discover their voice.
Dance
Dance
Our Dance provision continues to grow. From ballet to street dance, modern to Charleston, our weekly clubs and curriculum sessions mean Dance is part of the rhythm of everyday life at Cumnor. We believe in the discipline of dance and the skills it trains for life. We offer a range of classes in our purpose-built Dance Studio and collaborate with renowned dance companies such as ZooNation to widen our provision and increase its appeal to all our pupils.
Our commitment to the Performing Arts does not stop at the school gates; our love of the arts is something that we share with our wider community.
Matilda the Musical Jr
For 2026 a superb ensemble of Year 7 pupils threw themselves into the wonderful world of musical theatre with boundless energy, infectious curiosity and plenty of courage. It was an absolute triumph and we are delighted to have received five nominations by the National School Theatre Awards in recognition of this, before being awarded Best Prep School Production. You can read their detailed review here.

It has enabled our keenest and most talented pupils win Drama Scholarships to Brighton College, Worth, Eastbourne, Tonbridge, King’s Canterbury, Hurstpierpoint and Ardingly over the last few years.
Mrs Harris, Director of drama
Drama
Drama
Every single child from Reception to Year 8 will have the opportunity to perform in at least one of our 30+ events each year. From intimate coffee concerts and drama showcases, to seasonal concerts, variety shows, nativity plays, musicals and our annual set piece, the outdoor Shakespeare performance.
Whether their dream is to perform centre-stage, to design the set, create the stage make-up or be a sound or lighting technician, every child has an important role to play.
LAMDA
LAMDA
Drama at Cumnor opens doors, builds futures and creates lasting confidence. As part of our Performing Arts Programme, from Year 4 we offer the opportunity to work towards London Academy of Music and Dramatic Arts (LAMDA) examinations.
A wonderful way to learn important life skills, pupils take part in fun, imaginative and expressive lessons, encouraging confidence and the development of communication and physical awareness. Each grade encourages and challenges different aspects of text, language, creativity and vocal strength; inspiring young minds to discover their voice.
Dance
Dance
Our Dance provision continues to grow. From ballet to street dance, modern to Charleston, our weekly clubs and curriculum sessions mean Dance is part of the rhythm of everyday life at Cumnor. We believe in the discipline of dance and the skills it trains for life. We offer a range of classes in our purpose-built Dance Studio and collaborate with renowned dance companies such as ZooNation to widen our provision and increase its appeal to all our pupils.
Our commitment to the Performing Arts does not stop at the school gates; our love of the arts is something that we share with our wider community.
Matilda the Musical Jr
For 2026 a superb ensemble of Year 7 pupils threw themselves into the wonderful world of musical theatre with boundless energy, infectious curiosity and plenty of courage. It was an absolute triumph and we are delighted to have received five nominations by the National School Theatre Awards in recognition of this, before being awarded Best Prep School Production. You can read their detailed review here.
Matilda the Musical Jr

Music
At Cumnor, music is a source of enjoyment, creativity and self-expression. We nurture children’s natural love of music, developing their skills and confidence while encouraging them to discover their own musical voice.
Weekly music lessons in our historic Music Barn open up a world of musical styles, helping children develop their skills, discover new favourites and find their own ways to express themselves through music.
With nine ensembles meeting each week and more than 80% of pupils in Years 3 and 4 learning an instrument, there are plenty of opportunities to get involved, make music with others and discover just how much they can achieve.
Led by an experienced pianist and Musical Director whose professional credits include numerous national tours and West End productions, our Music Department combines high standards with a commitment to expanding opportunities for every child.
We are proud of the pupils who have gone on to win music scholarships at leading senior schools, including King’s Canterbury, Ardingly, Brighton College and Eton. Our commitment to musical excellence was also recognised through our shortlist for Best for Music in The Week Independent Schools Guide 2025, alongside two cathedral schools.
Developing our choirs and orchestra is a particular priority, inspiring the next generation of orchestral musicians and ensuring that music continues to thrive as the beating heart of the school.
Mr Cousins, Director of Music
The joy of learning
The joy of learning
Our Music provision comes in many shapes in sizes. From exploring and mastering a new instrument – from piano to harp, and electric guitar to gamelan – to all types of singing, as soloists, choristers and in musical theatre.
A busy calendar of events gives every child the chance to perform, from our informal coffee concerts to instrument-specific recitals, fully staged musicals and our seasonal showcases, Winter Wonderland and the Summer Serenade.
Community Music Day
Community Music Day
The highlight of the musical calendar is our ambitious Community Music Day, now entering its fourth year. Bringing together professional and amateur musicians, children, and adults for an intensive one-day community music event, we have performed a range of musical styles from community opera to jazz and folk.
This year, we take on an evening of hit songs from West End and Broadway musicals, alongside performers from London’s West End, Eastbourne Collage, St Andrew’s Prep and professional performers from Goldmans Management, accompanied by a live band under the direction of Musical Director Robert Cousins.

Destinations and scholarships
We are an outstanding school that produces dynamic and creative young people, well prepared and ready for their next steps, confident of who they are and what they can do.
We are proud to prepare our Year 8 leavers for a range of destination schools, including all of Sussex’s outstanding independent senior schools, and the very best weekly and full boarding schools across the country.
We are a non-selective school. Notwithstanding, our pupils have secured a remarkable 163 scholarship awards over the past five years with 72% of this year’s leavers winning scholarships including 6 Performing Arts, 11 Academic, 7 Sport and 6 Creative Arts. We are also truly independent, sending our children onto 52 different senior schools in the last ten years.
We put this success down to the individualised attention that every child in our school receives. It is what sets us apart, and it is what enables all our pupils to achieve such outstanding results.
2025 Leavers Destination Senior Schools
Reflections from Cumnor parents
Senior school pathways
Senior school pathways
Choosing a senior school starts in Year 5 with a talk for all parents. After this, we arrange private one-to-one meetings to discuss individual choices, longlisting, shortlisting and then final choices.
When the time comes to look at future schools, we offer personalised advice and targeted support, founded on longstanding relationships with our senior school partners.
Fergus Llewellyn, Headmaster
You are in very capable hands. We advise you at every stage of the process including personalised, thorough and targeted academic support.

Ladybirds Baby & Toddler Mornings
A relaxed morning for families with children from birth to four. Come along to play, explore and enjoy a coffee while meeting other local parents.
We know how important community is when you have a little one.
‘Ladybirds’ is a friendly, relaxed space where your child can play, explore and make friends, while you meet other local parents, enjoy a coffee and have experienced Early Years professionals on hand for the everyday questions we all have as parents.
Is my child developing as they should? How can I help with sleep or routines? What’s normal at this age? Whatever is on your mind, our experienced team is here to offer friendly advice, practical ideas and reassurance. No question is too small!
Our team brings a wealth of Early Years experience, including Norland training, postgraduate Early Years qualifications, consultancy expertise and extensive Reception teaching experience.
Friday mornings
Friday mornings
Each week brings something different for little ones to enjoy, from messy and water play to outdoor exploration, singing, dance, movement and storytelling. Children can explore our purpose-built Nursery and fully enclosed bespoke outdoor playground, giving them plenty of freedom to play while you relax, connect and enjoy the morning too.
Join us on Friday mornings at 10am during term time. This session is open to all children from birth to four years of age, accompanied by parents, grandparents, guardians or carers.
We look forward to seeing you!

Partnerships and values
We are committed to our enduring role in the community. Our doors are always open, and we warmly welcome all those who share in daily life at Cumnor.
Community
Community
Cumnor is part of the fabric of the local Sussex community. So, it matters that we are ready to serve this community and in so doing, discover the best in ourselves. This commitment does not stop at our gates; we are passionate about sharing our love of science, sport, reading and the Performing Arts, and work closely with local primary schools to improve access and inspire new generations.
These initiatives include our Community Music Day, Get Up & Dance, our partnership with Cuckfield Bookfest, termly sports festivals, Wednesday ‘open labs’ and school Shakespeare performances among others.
Follow us @cumnorhousesussex to find out more.
Philanthropy
Philanthropy
The Cumnor Foundation is the cornerstone of our fundraising and philanthropy. Dedicated to creating transformational bursaries, the Foundation is unique in covering the entire cost of a child’s education at an independent school for ten years from the ages of 8 to 18.
In less than ten years, The Cumnor Foundation has already made a mark, creating life-changing opportunities every year for local children with the potential, but otherwise not the means, to join Cumnor House Sussex.
The Cumnor Foundation
Fundraising
Fundraising
Driven by collective community effort, we support local causes that are close to our hearts, where our contribution can have real impact. Our ‘charities of the year’ are nominated by children, parents and staff.
Led by our generous parent body, our campaigns have raised over £150,000 in the past three years from much anticipated events including our Christmas Fair, Fireworks Night and Summer Fête. We also help to tackle food poverty in our local Sussex region through donations to local foodbanks as part of our Harvest celebrations.

Art and design
We value art highly at Cumnor, inspiring all our budding artists to express themselves freely, and with confidence. Our reputation for excellence is founded in nurturing individual creativity.
We are firing young imaginations, nurturing individual creativity and developing technical skills for the future.
We challenge children to develop their own, original ideas, and support them with the practical elements that enable them to become technically proficient.
Raising the bar, and drawing on her background in textile design, our dedicated Head of Art encourages children to work with a wide range of materials and processes in both 2D and 3D media, including sketching, painting, printmaking, textiles, ceramics, sculpture and animation.
A sketchbook work culture sits at the heart of our approach, encouraging everyone to keep art journals and to instil a lifelong love of drawing.
Our distinct approach is consistently recognised through the number of Art Scholarships our children have secured at a range of senior schools including Brighton College, King’s Canterbury, Tonbridge, Eastbourne and Hurst.
Kerrie Pope, Head of Art
Joined by inspirational artists and art educators, our children regularly enjoy masterclasses, all taking place in the Art Studio, a dedicated, light-filled space with a mezzanine area for our Scholars’ enrichment program. We also hold an annual exhibition of our Scholars’ work to much acclaim.
Beautifully curated, the standard and variety of work was breath-taking.

Design technology
Practical and future-focused, DT at Cumnor is designed for a fast-changing world where agility and creativity is key.
Under visionary leadership, DT at Cumnor has gone from strength to strength. We work with real life problems and projects relevant for today’s world – with sustainability in mind.
Housed in our dedicated STEM facility, our state-of-the-art DT lab is unrivalled in a prep school setting and is a hive of activity, innovation and creative confidence. With our open-door policy, pupils can drop in whenever they have a moment – so break times are never quiet!
Our DT program focuses on giving pupils the technical knowledge and skills to bring their ideas to life. Building their understanding of resistant materials, graphics, electronics and computer-aided design and manufacture using lasers, we give them the tools to innovate.
This practical, future-focused approach not only brings unusual agility in problem-solving to all our children. It has also brought the school significant scholarship success, too, with no less than five DT scholarships in the last year alone, to leading senior schools including Brighton College and King’s Canterbury.
Tori Bramly, Head of DT
A racing start
A racing start
Now a regular fixture in Cumnor’s STEM calendar, our annual go-kart project pits together teams of Year 6 pupils to dismantle and re-build a working kart, then test and race it. Challenging their scientific and mathematical knowledge throughout, the project culminates in a competitive race.
This year it was off to Plumpton to hone their driving skills as they competed in the drag race, slalom, chicane sprint, lap of champions and pit-stop challenge.
Come and see STEM in action
A warm welcome awaits. Our informal personal visits will show you why Cumnor is an exceptional experience.
